_comment: MEGA-MODE launch recipe for MegaMoE V2 EP8. All selectable implementations are authored by this workflow. The hand-written M2.5 tree is never registered, run, copied, used as a base, or exposed to an agent; only its independently recorded 8192_uniform result (1.0448x, observed band 1.0403..1.0477) is a target. One persistent candidate lane reconstructs M2.5 from the validated megamoe_ep_mega_fusion skill, while unrelated search lanes continue independently. Every candidate is measured against the same frozen public-AITER denominator and the fastest fully verified candidate is selected. ${...} placeholders are resolved by scripts/bootstrap_task.sh.
_mode_comment: mode=mega selects the megafusion path in kernel_workflow.js: the skill-consuming roles are pointed DIRECTLY at skills/megamoe_ep_mega_fusion/skill.md (not the generic index.yaml auto-match, so no collision with the persistent-fusion card), and the whole-topology / reproduction-authorized / fix-the-substrate methodology relaxation is injected in-prompt. MODE!=='mega' code paths are byte-identical to optimize/author; this field is the only switch.
_objective_comment: Mega uses one shared optimization loop with independent candidate lanes. Lane-local WIP may be committed and resumed even when slow; it never changes the selected incumbent. The M2.5 skill lane is reserved but non-blocking, and ordinary TechLead search runs in the remaining rounds without receiving the exact M2.5 recipe. Performance is rank-max operator_e2e against the frozen scattered baseline. Only a complete calibrated score can enter final selection.
_audit_profile_overrides: For an exhaustive audit set mega_profile=audit, budget=15, mega_stop_on_deliverable=false, mega_candidate_timeout_s=3600, mega_final_timeout_s=3600, mega_time_budget_s=28800, mega_final_reserve_s=3600, mega_closeout_reserve_s=900, mega_skill_max_attempts=6, mega_skill_initial_burst=0, mega_skill_interval=3, mega_final_top_k=2, mega_final_fallback_k=2, mega_tie_noise_pct=1.45, require_overlap=true, require_attribution=true, and both 512 required_pairs entries to 16.
_require_artifact_distinct_comment: ON for measurement integrity: candidate and baseline arms must resolve to different JIT artifacts. This is not a plagiarism check and does not compare against M2.5 source, which is not an input.
_require_hardware_activation_comment: ON (same as optimize). A switched / perf-bearing candidate is committable and counts as on-device progress ONLY if the verifier reports activation_on_hardware=yes -- the switched path traced+launched on a card THIS round (a gpu_lock benchmark/correctness with the switch set, backed by a device-side observable: nonzero mega_e2e, a rocprof/trace record, or the on-device path marker). A py_compile, a COMPILE_ONLY ISA hash, or a CPU dry-run is NOT hardware activation. Three consecutive rounds in which nothing reaches the device hard-stop the wave. In mega mode this is the primary guard against the last wave's failure: the whole-topology body must reach the card and clear the r12 cut4 boundary, not defer a trace-time fault across rounds.
_acceptance_comment: PRODUCTION profile: score tier requires hardware activation, path=MEGA x8, exactly two launches, relL2<0.10, 30 clean replays and paired 8192_uniform rank-max timing. The fastest candidate is validated first; fallback is paid only if it fails. The selected candidate pays all regression guards, arrival-jittered 256 replays, graph/artifact/exact-head checks. Overlap and attribution are optional diagnostics, not shipping gates. Audit runs may set mega_profile=audit, budget=15, top_k=2, require_overlap/attribution=true and 16 pairs for 512 guards.
_state_comment: STATE persists every candidate lane independently. A failed or slow skill attempt does not replace or block search candidates; a later wave resumes the exact lane HEAD and evidence manifest.
_gpu_comment: This is a collective: the group form of the lease takes all 8 cards as ONE lease. Production bounds each candidate attempt to 1200s and the task command to 20 minutes; timeout preserves lane WIP and moves on rather than occupying an hour.
_use_expert_skills_comment: REQUIRED for the m25_skill lane only. The exact recipe is injected only into mega_engineer; TechLead and ordinary Engineers do not receive it, so other search directions are not anchored on M2.5.
_analysis_skill_comment: ENABLED: the moe_bottleneck analysis skill enriches the generic bottleneck classification with this operator's route/expert imbalance and Stage1/Stage2/combine time-share, justifying WHICH edges the one-shot topology fuses.
_capability_eval_comment: FALSE: this run is for its OUTPUT (a fast fused kernel that beats M2.5), not for evaluating whether the loop can derive the fusion blind. With capability_eval off there is no reference-containment gate and no plagiarized verdict; the mega skill's concrete arithmetic is usable in full.
_known_reference_paths_comment: Empty. No hand-authored M2.5 source address is an input; the candidate is authored from the public baseline plus the validated skill.

positive_control.name: synthetic slowdown: calibrated device-side delay on the measured operator stream
positive_control.how: Build the control in an isolated /tmp copy; never touch a candidate lane. Measure >=8 base-vs-base null pairs first. Add a bounded device-side delay that executes on the measured operator stream for every EP rank and is visible in the same rank-max span. Prefer an env/JIT-keyed delay at the persistent-kernel entry across resident blocks; if that location saturates below the required effect, use a dedicated tiny calibration kernel immediately inside the measured span. Do not reuse the old Stage2-local spin that maxed below the noise floor. Anchor the switch in the JIT cache key, record distinct disk/ISA hashes, and verify a device trace contains the delay. Dose it until >=5 interleaved pairs unanimously produce -4%..-9% and clear 3x the worst null pair. Write the aggregate and evidence manifest atomically; claim_complete stays false until all pairs and hashes are final.
positive_control._magnitude_comment: REQUIRED. The band above is a TARGET a synthetic knob was aimed at, not a previously measured fact. With magnitude=constructed the gate still requires the right sign, unanimity across pairs, and >=3x the WORST null pair -- it only tolerates landing above half the target. Do NOT relabel a recorded control as constructed to get past a failure.
positive_control._abort_on_fail_comment: A failed or incomplete control does not abort candidate authoring; it keeps performance calibration pending, so no candidate can be ranked or shipped until a complete control passes. claim_complete prevents force-emitted 0.00% from being read as failure.
positive_control._control_strength_comment: The benchmark engineer must construct a stronger device-side delay than the old Stage2-local spin if that knob cannot clear the null spread. Null-only is not a positive control.

_require_task_graph_comment: Analyze must still emit the tile-level dependency DAG as a structured artifact (nodes, edges, edge scope, what enforces each edge today, critical path, slack, declared unknowns) before the one-shot topology is committed -- see knowledge/tile_task_graph.md and the ANALYZE_SCHEMA task_graph field. In mega mode this justifies WHICH edges the whole-topology design fuses (and guards against 'the stages are serialized, so fuse them' restatements); it is not a derivation-from-blind requirement. The gate does not abort; it emits a caveat that travels to the report.
